title: run-manifest.json
description: Machine-readable execution contract produced by the test-scenarios `build_test_kit` stage (and regenerated by run-tests-dev if missing). Maps each scenario to an ordered list of steps that the dev-test-runner executes verbatim against dev via `aidp http|mongo|sqs`.

kit_dir.description: Absolute path the `artifact` fields are relative to (the test kit directory).

variables.description: Named values (e.g. base_url placeholders) substituted into artifacts at run time.

artifact.description: Relative path (from kit_dir) to the runnable artifact, e.g. http/SC-1.http, mongo/SC-1-verify.js, sqs/SC-1-message.json.

queue.description: For sqs steps: logical queue name or URL.

isolated.description: False when this step's effect isn't scoped to this scenario alone (e.g. a broad scheduled-job trigger matching other dev records/scenarios too) — every scenario must otherwise be independent; a step marked false is a known, called-out exception, not the norm.

expect.description: Expected observable outcome. Free-form but conventionally {status}, {contains}, {rows_min}, {equals}, etc. null = no assertion (setup/cleanup).
